decision_reason: Previous Cursor host artifacts show built-in backend/model metadata attempts, and repository-local plan/artifact review found requirements for a safe launch/network-isolation contract but not the contract itself. Under the current no-external-AI/model-call boundary, Cursor must not be relaunched until the preflight contract exists and passes.

local_config_docs_review.finding: Local plan/artifacts require a safe Cursor launch/network-isolation contract, but no reviewed contract proving absence of built-in backend/model metadata calls was found.

required_evidence_for_future_yes: Exact Cursor executable, version, process tree, command line, isolated user-data dir, isolated extensions dir, extension development path and extension tests path.
Repository-local or approved local documentation/config proving offline/no-backend/no-model-metadata behavior for Cursor built-in services before launch.
Process-bound or sandbox-bound network isolation active before Cursor launch, with evidence that the rule applies to the exact Cursor proof process tree.
No successful outbound network connections from the Cursor proof process tree during the run.

No stdout/stderr/host-log matches for availableModels, getDefaultModelNudgeData, pricing, availableDocs, user privacy mode, backendUrl, repoBackendUrl, telemBackendUrl, cmdkBackendUrl, geoCppBackendUrl, cppConfigBackendUrl, agentBackendUrlPrivacy or agentBackendUrlNonPrivacy.
Same-run request, response, core trace, host trace, correlation id, freshness, redaction and cleanup artifacts for any command/panel/chat/negative rows attempted after preflight passes.
All claim locks remain false unless later bounded phases provide their own evidence.

future_cursor_relaunch_work_order_status.reason: The required preflight launch/network-isolation contract does not exist yet.
future_cursor_relaunch_work_order_status.future_template_only: After a separate bounded preflight packet proves the exact safe launch/network-isolation contract, a later work order may run Cursor with only the approved executable/args and must stop on any backend/model metadata attempt.

what_this_proves: Cursor cannot be safely relaunched now under the current evidence because no verified safe launch/network-isolation contract was found.
Previous Cursor proof/repair artifacts record built-in backend/model metadata attempts.
The Cursor track is deferred/blocked without stopping the independent Codex proof track.
what_this_does_not_prove: Full Cursor chat participant UI/app proof.
Token savings, quality improvement, semantic quality, learnability, target promotion, final readiness or product readiness.
